recovery: Only the missing final candidate session was rerun from a fresh process with the exact archived harness; original nine complete sessions retained. One full short warm-up and both measured workloads; separate 180-second cap.

proof.sequence: all fixed cases in order, then first case again; fresh worker object, policy aliases and state normalizer per game
proof.verification: all normalized authority frames, both actor observation hashes, every emitted seed, extra cached reads and preview immutability; same fixed commands and natural terminal state
proof.limitation: finite pinned two-deck traces only; does not certify all native global state or full Standard behavior; command latencies include full presentation and IPC and are diagnostic, not batch throughput
